title: ONE POINT FROM THREE GAMES. THEN HEARTS WENT TO THUN AND LOST 3-1
description:
32nd out of 36 before kick-off. The foot of the table is getting closer.

Thun won 3-1 at the Stockhorn Arena. Hearts left with one goal and homework. They started the night 32nd out of 36, and that's not a typo.

Hearts did get one back late on. Credit for effort, but the table doesn't hand out points for that.

Before this: 7-1 at Celtic Park, then 2-0 at Trabzonspor. Quite the tour. It's one point from four games now, and the foot of the table is a lot closer than it was.

Is this a blip or a proper slump for Hearts? Pick one and tell us why.
